newsitem.title: USA: U.S West Coast crudes flat, Alaska crude sold Wed..
newsitem.headline: U.S West Coast crudes flat, Alaska crude sold Wed..

text.p: U.S. West Coast light crude prices stayed flat early Thursday with a deal done late yesterday at $1.45 under March West Texas Intermediate (WTI), traders said.
The full cargo sold at $1.45 under March, the same level as the last sale January 17.
Trade was otherwise thin as most players attended the West Coast Crude Oil Conference Thursday.
Heavy crude markets were quiet, with no deals reportd Thursday, but pressure remaining after Tosco declared force majeure Monday on about 40,000 bpd of heavy crude.
With heavy crude prices expected to drop below their current $17.25 range, refiners were looking at ways to run heavies instead of light grades.
Traders said discounts remained 50 to 25 cents under postings. Texaco on Tuesday lowered their posted prices 50 cents and Wednesday Unocal dropped their posting the same amount.
Lower postings pulled down the average price for Kern River about five cnets from Tuesday to $17.25/17.50 cents.
